newsitem.title: URUGUAY: Uruguay's wholesale prices up 1.9 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay's wholesale prices up 1.9 pct in Sept.

text.p: Uruguay's wholesale prices rose 1.9 percent in September versus 2.3 percent in August and 1.9 percent in September 1995, the Central Bank said Monday.
In the 12 months to September, wholesale prices rose 24.1 percent, down from 35.7 percent over the same period last year, the bank said.

Wholesale prices for fishing products rose 5.6 percent, agriculture and livestock 2.9 percent and manufactured goods 1.5 percent. Among manufactured products, surgical and photographic equipment's wholesale inflation was 3.7 percent, rubber derivatives' 3.6 percent and beverages' 3.3 percent.
